topics.name: Agents & orchestration
topics.description: How agents divide work, coordinate roles and share context.
topics.guide: Start with the workflow you want to improve. Compare how these sources coordinate roles, then test the smallest useful agent setup on one real task.

topics.name: Coding workflows & skills
topics.description: Planning, building, evaluating and resuming work with coding assistants.
topics.guide: Compare planning and execution loops. Pick one repeatable workflow, define a useful test or metric, and keep a short record of what helped.

topics.name: Integrations & interfaces
topics.description: Connecting assistants to software through CLIs, MCP and messaging.
topics.guide: Choose the integration around the task you need. Compare context use, access and ease of operation; treat source-specific performance numbers as claims to test.

topics.name: Production reliability
topics.description: Monitoring, diagnosis, sandboxed fixes and review of production changes.
topics.guide: Trace the loop from detection to diagnosis, testing and human review. Choose one narrow failure mode before applying an automated recovery workflow.

topics.name: Search & multimodal
topics.description: Finding useful information across video and other non-text sources.
topics.guide: Start with a specific search task and a small sample of your own material. Check whether returned moments support the query before relying on them.
